cases.intent: Accept a synthetic signed design artifact with expected repository, workflow, source revision, subject digest and predicate scope.
Accept a synthetic signed inspection package bound to exact article, lot, characteristic, instrument/calibration and inspection-event identities.
Accept a complete signed chain from design export through manufacturing plan/execution to exact article and inspection result.

cases.intent: Reject a mathematically valid signature from a signer absent from the independent trust root.
cases.seeded_attack: Use a generated key not present in the configured trust policy.

cases.intent: Reject a trusted signer whose authorization does not cover the asserted predicate or artifact class.
cases.seeded_attack: Reuse a build-only signer for an engineering approval predicate.

cases.intent: Reject a valid signed source-generation artifact replayed against a newer target generation.

cases.intent: Reject a valid signature bound to a different component, variant, article, lot, characteristic or inspection event.
cases.seeded_attack: Substitute one exact subject reference while keeping display labels unchanged.

cases.intent: Reject missing, reordered or spliced provenance edges in a multi-stage artifact chain.
cases.seeded_attack: Omit or replace one intermediate transformation or execution event.

cases.intent: Reject trust-root or trust-policy material supplied only by the untrusted package.
cases.seeded_attack: Replace verifier root and package signature with attacker-controlled pair.

cases.intent: Reject silent downgrade or incompatible profile reinterpretation.
cases.seeded_attack: Replace a required profile with a weaker or unsupported version.

cases.intent: Reject a signature whose credential is expired or revoked under the independently configured policy.

cases.intent: Reject freshness claims built on manipulated timestamps or mismatched clock domains.
cases.seeded_attack: Shift timestamps or change timebase while retaining data bytes.

cases.intent: Prevent integrity or build provenance from being promoted into evidence admission, verification, approval or release.

cases.intent: Reject cross-organization or tenant identity collision despite identical friendly names.
cases.seeded_attack: Use another organization/repository/supplier identity with the same display name.
